article.title: After the midterms, the U.S.-Israel military relationship is changing — but it’s not all good news for the Palestine movement
article.author: Joseph Mogul
article.content: The U.S. midterm results were a stunning rebuke of the Iran war and the U.S.-Israel relationship, but defense analyst Bill Hartung says not all the policy changes being proposed in response to shifting political winds will help Palestinians.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
